summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a Form 6-K with exhibits announcing the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held June 24, 2026. All nine director nominees were elected. Each Class A exchangeable subordinate voting share receives one vote, representing a 25% aggregate voting interest, while Class B multiple voting shares have 368,972,004 votes representing 75%. This is a routine annual meeting outcome with no acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. Filing maps to a routine Form 8-K Item 5.07 meeting results disclosure.
